scene_timeline.audio_description: If you like fakeaways, then you will love these air fryer tandoori chicken skewers.

parsed_output.overall_summary: Nathan Anthony (@boredoflunch) demonstrates how to make a low-calorie 'fakeaway' meal of Airfryer Tandoori Chicken Skewers. He marinates chicken thighs in a mixture of yogurt, lemon, garlic, tomato puree, and traditional Indian spices before air frying them for 17 minutes. The dish is served with a homemade mint and lime yogurt dip, yellow rice, and flatbread, totaling 587 calories per serving.

people.description: Male creator seen only by his hands while preparing food.

takeaways.statement: Tandoori chicken can be made quickly and healthily in an air fryer in 17 minutes at 200°C.
Using red food coloring is optional but gives the chicken its traditional vibrant tandoori appearance.

items.name: Chicken Marinade
items.details: 400g chicken (thigh or breast), 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 heaped tbsp yogurt, 1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tbsp garlic purée, 1 tsp ground ginger, salt, pepper, 1 tsp oil, juice of a lemon, 1 tsp red food coloring (optional).

items.name: Mint & Lime Yogurt
items.details: 1-2 tbsp fat-free yogurt, fresh mint, lime juice, pepper.

items.name: Cooking Instructions
items.details: Coat chicken in marinade, thread onto skewers, air fry for 17 minutes at 200°C.
